pages.text: A blue-grey tree with a full set of wood. Sniffers dig up its saplings, and $(item)Lanternfruit Seeds$() left a week in a kiln grow into one.$(br2)$(item)Lanternfruit$() hangs under the leaves and glows from within when ripe. After dark, moths come to it.
Gloamwood planks, stairs and slabs left under open sky fade, then weather, then turn silver, a patch at a time, the way copper does.
Honeycomb waxes them where they stand, and an axe scrapes them back.$(br2)The stonecutter cuts the planks into nineteen patterns, each with stairs and slabs.
pages.title: Weathering

pages.text: Two fruit, sugar and a glass bottle. Five days in a kiln turns the must into $(item)Lanternwine$(), or three in a dark cellar.
Crafting with Lanternfruit leaves the peel behind. Four peels around a torch make a lamp. Three days in a kiln candies the fruit.
